WHAT THIS PLAN STILL LACKS

Serengeti plains is not in the plan, although the board offers it. The open savanna game drives are the core of any northern-circuit safari and merit the most nights. Keep one of Grumeti River Area Game Drive on the Discovery Board and rebuild.

Chemka Hot Springs
